capture.zh: 完成主线任务《阿洛比斯的哀鸣》后参加活动《黑暗的月影之光》（晚上19-20点）：阿洛比斯每6分钟可挑战一次，最开始100级，之后每次挑战等级下降10级；打败它获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 不必第一次就硬拼：每次挑战（输赢都）有10万经验券和B级技能石，阿洛比斯等级逐次降低后再用光、草、水系精灵击败。

engine_notes: level_drops_per_attempt: the first attempt is Lv100; each further attempt the boss is 10 levels lower (100 → 90 → 80 …). The remake keeps a per-save attempt counter for this boss; floor not stated (assume 50).
consolation_reward: every attempt, won or lost, gives 100000 EXP ticket + a B-grade skill stone (item ids are placeholders).
The 4399 page does not explicitly say the win gives a 精元 — the event was the way to obtain 阿洛比斯; essence of the base form 安普 (#1118) assumed, matching other 2012 essence pets.
HP not published (5000 estimate); skills are the species' top learnset skills.
6-minute cooldown and 19-20点 window are real-time limits, dropped.

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
Level and HP are not published (difficulty ★ per 7k7k); Lv60 / 600 HP follow the door-1..5 pattern of HP ≈ 10×level and are estimates.
bosses.source_note: 7k7k BOSS打法全攻略 (2010-06-02) lists 试练之门 卡特斯 ★; official 图鉴 calls it the trial guardian.

location.zh: 帕诺星系 各星球（随机出现）

label.zh: 周一、周五：2回合内击败盖亚
周二、周四、周日：用致命一击击败盖亚
周三、周六：对战10回合后再击败盖亚（提前击败无效）

capture.zh: 盖亚每天13:00和20:00各出现30分钟，随机出现在帕诺星系的星球上（派特博士会通知）；按当天曜日的规则击败才能获得盖亚精元，没按规则打败不给精元。首次击败获成就「击败盖亚」，三种规则全部完成获「完胜盖亚」。

strategy_notes.zh: 2回合规则：先消强化，用克制战斗系的超能/飞行精灵（艾克里桑、闪尼、艾贝多芬）两下或一次暴击打死，或秒杀技；致命一击规则：同上，靠运气或致命能量珠；10回合规则：伊娅丝魔力针刺消强、虚弱光线减攻后加血硬撑，或该隐暗影护盾轮流抵挡，满10回合后再打死。

engine_notes: Three weekday objectives become variants the player picks (no real-time clock). The top-level win is plain ko_all for a free practice fight; the 精元 is granted only when a variant's objectives are met.
ko_after_turn {turns:10}: KOing 盖亚 before turn 10 ends the battle as a failure (提前击败无法获得精元). Counts 10 of its turns/attacks.
turn_limit {turns:2} as a win objective = won within 2 turns.
Innate boost (天生强化，需消除) — stat and amount not stated; atk+1 assumed.
Level not given in any source found; 70 is an estimate (2010 帕诺星系 legendaries).
Hourly windows (13:00/20:00 30 min) are dropped per foundation 7.2.
bosses.source_note: 7k7k 盖亚 pages (2010-04-12, 2011-03-16): HP 2000, 战斗系, 天生强化, weekday rules; 4399 Q&A confirms the rules and 2000 HP.

location.zh: 怀特星

capture.zh: 在怀特星挑战大地之神卡修斯，打败获得「卡茨的精元」，经分子转化器孵化得到卡茨（进化链 卡茨→卡修→卡修斯）。

strategy_notes.zh: 地面暗影系，被草、飞行、光系克制。丽莎布布先用叶绿光束消掉天生攻击+2，再用克制系输出；或光系（厄尔塞拉）、谱尼长期消耗配合回复与防御强化；也可魔焰猩猩绝命火焰秒杀。卡修斯单次伤害约120-170（消强后）。

engine_notes: Innate atk+2 (天生攻击强化+2), clearable.
融入黑暗 makes the player's skill fail if 卡修斯 moves first that turn (1 turn); 量子绝灭波 30% to add 50 fixed damage per turn for 3 turns.
Reward essence is 卡茨的精元 (base form #796), so the item slug is essence_kaci.
A later guide (9游) says it only appears 12:00-13:00 and 19:00-20:00 and that 'it reverses your boosts (它会翻转)'. Time windows are dropped; the reversal is not in the 2011 4399 page and is not encoded.
4399 files this page under its SPT section (2011-08 compilation); it was assigned here as a 战神联盟 legendary.
bosses.source_note: 4399 卡修斯介绍及攻略 (2011): 70级, 地面暗影, 约5000血, 天生攻击+2, skills 量子绝灭波/连山绝壑/融入黑暗/幻化灭影, reward 卡茨的精元.

location.zh: （三周年活动「龙族大浩劫·布里克VS帕罗狄亚」）

capture.zh: 2012年4月29日13:00-14:00 三周年庆「龙族大浩劫」中的「布里克VS帕罗狄亚」对决（形式参照「天马VS阿洛比斯」）：玩家帮助龙族守卫军（布里克）攻打念力之王帕罗狄亚，击败后获得精元，合成/孵化得到初级形态帕罗。

strategy_notes.zh: 未找到同期具体打法；飞行超能系，被电、冰、暗影（对超能）系克制。

engine_notes: Story: 帕罗狄亚's clan was to be sealed by the old dragon king; 龙王子哈莫雷特 later makes amends. The event was a one-hour server-wide face-off; some sources say every kill gave a 精元 fragment and 'enough' of them made 帕罗 — count unknown, so one essence per win is used.
Level, HP, rules and skills are NOT published in any source found; 80 / 5000 and the top learnset skills are placeholders.
bosses.source_note: 4399 帕罗狄亚 图鉴: obtained in the 4月29日13-14点 小布VS帕罗狄亚 event; no battle data published.

location.zh: 精灵太空站 勇者之塔 神秘领域

capture.zh: 第1封印：除了必中技能，其他所有技能都是MISS，包括属性技能（强化自身、弱化对手）。 击败后解开该封印，进入下一封印；七个封印全部解开后挑战谱尼真身才能获得谱尼精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 查尔顿虚张声势后不停固若金汤耗完谱尼35PP（圣光气后换无用精灵送死两次），再换哈莫雷特龙之意志强化后用必中的龙王波打死。

engine_notes: only_sure_hit_moves_land: every player move that is not 必中 (MustHit) misses — attacks AND status moves. damage_only_from {sure_hit:true} is the damage half of the same rule.

no_struggle: when 谱尼 has no PP left it cannot act. The universal 2010 strategy for seals 1-5 was 查尔顿 虚张声势 + 固若金汤 (and 超级药 heals) until 谱尼's 35 PP were spent, then finish it with a pet suited to the seal's rule.

Skills (4399 2010-10 seal guides, identical for every seal): 圣光气 10PP, 旋灭裂空阵 10PP, 圣灵魔闪光 5PP, 千烈虚光闪 10PP — 35 PP in total. 圣光气 makes its next two attacks certain crits (下两次攻击必定致命); the classic answer was to switch in two throw-away pets.
Level is not given by any source; 100 assumed (the battle showed ??? for seal bosses in some recollections).
Unlock of the whole line: light the two small lamps beside 勇者之塔 in the 精灵太空站 resource area, then enter the red 神秘领域 (4399 谱尼 page).
Reward: none for the seal itself; progress unlocks the next seal (see chains/puni.json).

strategy_notes.zh: 查尔顿耗PP，哈莫雷特龙之意志强化6次后龙王波；谱尼复活后满PP，一边打一边加血，遇圣光气换精灵送死或回避两次。

strategy_notes.zh: 索尔大招，配合魔焰猩猩火焰旋涡（100%烧伤）、鲁斯王漩涡（100%冻伤）、光鸟圣炎、哈尔翼蜂剧毒针刺等威力技能附加状态；毒粉这种纯属性技能无效；谱尼容易MISS，需要一定运气。

engine_notes: status_moves_always_miss: every player skill of category 属性 (status) misses against it (matches 谱尼's own 圣洁 skill effect '属性攻击对自身必定miss'), so statuses can only be applied as secondary effects of damaging skills.

label.zh: 第1命：虚无+圣洁, 天生攻击+2
第5命：虚无+圣洁+永恒, 天生双防+2
第6命：轮回(准)+圣洁+永恒, 体力低于1000回满

capture.zh: 解开七个封印后挑战谱尼真身；谱尼有6条命（相当于6v6），依次拥有各封印的特性；全部击败获得谱尼精元（另有「传说」称号的说法）。

strategy_notes.zh: 哈莫雷特（满级、双防/体力/攻击努力值，带腰带和双防刻印）龙之意志强化6次后龙王波为主力，魔焰猩猩辅助；仙女龙、闪光艾菲亚等耗招，闪光依依毒粉+寄生种子；最后一命血量低于1300时再用大招，一击打穿1000回满线。全程约1.5小时，需大量药剂（加血、活力药剂各近300个）。

engine_notes: Six lives = six consecutive Puni team members (7k7k 2011: '普尼有6命，其实就是6v6多精灵对战'). Each member carries its own seal traits in member_rules / member_phases — the engine needs per-team-member rules (encounter rules apply to all).

Life traits: 7k7k 2011 gives life 1 = 虚无+圣洁 with 天生攻击+2, life 5 = 圣洁+虚无+永恒 with 天生双防+2, life 6 = 轮回(准)+圣洁+永恒 refilling below 1000 HP; lives 2-4 = 元素/能量/生命 per the spinoff summary (TapTap) which matches 7k7k on lives 1, 5, 6.
heal_full_below 1000 on life 6: to win, the final hit must take it from ≥1000 to 0 in one blow (hence '血量低于1300时可使用大招').
4399 2010 also says the player's hit rate drops when 谱尼 is below 10000 HP (命中率70%) and that its crits remove the player's defence boosts (暴击破防) — not encoded.
Daily limit (once per day) is reported only for the spinoff; the remake has no clock, so attempts_per_day is null.
PP: lives 1-4 have finite PP (35 each), so no_struggle applies and the PP-exhaust tactic works; lives 5-6 have unlimited PP.

Skills (4399 2010-10 seal guides, identical for every seal): 圣光气 10PP, 旋灭裂空阵 10PP, 圣灵魔闪光 5PP, 千烈虚光闪 10PP — 35 PP in total. 圣光气 makes its next two attacks certain crits (下两次攻击必定致命); the classic answer was to switch in two throw-away pets.
Level is not given by any source; 100 assumed (the battle showed ??? for seal bosses in some recollections).
bosses.source_note: 4399 谱尼真身攻略 (2010-10) for lives and HP; 7k7k 2011-03-30 for the per-life seal traits; TapTap summary (spinoff) fills lives 2-4.

location.zh: 赫尔卡星 第三层 荒地（雷雨天）

capture.zh: 雷伊只在雷雨天出现在赫尔卡星第三层荒地：每个整点开始的前10分钟左右（早期为每晚20:00-22:00）。打败雷伊获得雷伊的精元，孵化得到雷伊（2011年起精元只在周五至周日发放）。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布单挑：叶绿光束消强化 → 花粉多次降低雷伊命中 → 光合作用补血 → 花草能量强化3次 → 叶绿光束打死（每下约500）；或满级卡鲁克斯破攻、大地之力强化后爆裂极突刺（每下1000-1200，暴击直接秒）；或该隐暗影护盾与攻击循环。

engine_notes: Storm encounter: 雷伊 only appears while it is 雷雨天 on 赫尔卡星 (hourly window). The remake has no clock — treat as always available, or as a map event that can be triggered once per in-game 'storm'.

Traits per 7k7k 2011 雷伊解析: 无视速度 (encoded as always_moves_first: 雷伊 acts first regardless of speed), 免疫属性技能, 天生强化, 高miss率. 免疫属性技能 is encoded as immune_status; classic strategies still lowered its accuracy with 花粉, so stat drops are NOT blocked.
高miss率 comes from its 电闪光 (speed -1, accuracy -1) — no separate rule.
heal_full_below 100: 7k7k 2011 boss guide says '血低于100会补满血' — the last hit must take it from ≥100 HP to 0.
Level: 7k7k 2011 says it started at 55 and was raised by 5 each time it returned, 70 at the time of writing; 70 used.
Innate boost stats not stated; atk+1 spe+1 assumed (it must be cleared with 叶绿光束 / 日月皆伤 style moves).
Weekday-only reward (Fri–Sun, 2011) dropped per foundation 7.2.
bosses.source_note: 7k7k 2011 雷伊解析: 赫尔卡星3层 整点10分钟, 体力2000, 无视速度/免疫属性技能/天生强化/高miss; 7k7k 2011 boss list: Lv55→70, 血低于100补满.

location.zh: 赫尔卡星 雷伊特训（湖边）

capture.zh: 雷伊特训第1关：只能派自己的雷伊出战，胜利后雷伊学会「极光刃」。

strategy_notes.zh: 雷伊学会白光刃的等级即可战胜：白光刃乱打，适当加血。

engine_notes: 雷伊特训 is a story line for the player's own 雷伊: only 雷伊 may fight (player_team_size 1 + require_player_species 70). The reward of each stage is a special skill learned by that 雷伊 (reward.learn_skill), not an essence; the engine needs a reward kind 'learn_skill {species, skill}' that adds the skill to the player's 雷伊's learnable list.
Skill ids 10823-10825 / 20363-20364 sit right after the 2009 skill range, so the training dates from late 2009 / early 2010.
Opponent levels and HP are not given by any source found; values are estimates.
skills: no source lists this opponent's skills; the species' top learnset skills are used.

capture.zh: 雷伊特训第2关：只能派自己的雷伊出战，胜利后雷伊学会「闪电斗气」。

strategy_notes.zh: 最好使用命中率高的极光刃，途中用一次雷雨天降双防，适当加血。

Below 1/8 HP every hit is a crit — trait of the 雷纳多 SPT boss (7k7k 2011), assumed to carry over.

location.zh: 赫尔卡星 雷伊特训（湖边）

note.zh: 雷伊特训第4关要求雷伊80级以上

capture.zh: 雷伊特训第4关：只能派自己的雷伊出战，胜利后雷伊学会「元气电光球」。

strategy_notes.zh: 雷伊80级以上：先用闪电斗气抵挡十回合（注意补血），十回合后雷祭麻痹它，充电后瞬雷天闪；它血量少于100会回满，需控制血量，在麻痹状态下一击KO。

engine_notes: Win needs all three: KO, not before turn 10 (ko_after_turn), and the finishing blow must land while 阿克希亚 is paralysed (script finish_while_foe_status {status: paralysis}).
heal_full_below 100 is the 阿克希亚 SPT trait ('血低于100会自动回血'), which the 9游 guide confirms for this stage.
Player 雷伊 level ≥ 80 required to challenge (unlock note).

location.zh: 赫尔卡星 雷伊特训（湖边）

capture.zh: 雷伊特训第5关：只能派自己的雷伊出战，胜利后雷伊学会「雷神天明闪」。

strategy_notes.zh: 前四项特训完成后，湖边出现小盖亚问「想成为真正的王者吗」，湖中出现蓝色的雷伊影子。带平衡能量珠，先用极光刃消强化，再用地面系S级技能石（对电4倍）两招解决，或极光刃重复打KO；须5回合内击败。

engine_notes: The opponent is a blue mirror 雷伊 (镜影雷伊); a mirror of the player's 雷伊 at the player's level would be most faithful (script mirror_player_monster) — fixed Lv100 used here.
Turn limit 5 from baidu jingyan ('5回合内击败雷伊的影子'); the shadow can copy boosts (4399 2012).
Pre-battle: if pirates are on the lake, shoot them with the head item first (map event).

location.zh: 卡酷星丛林（天界秘境入口）

capture.zh: 在卡酷星丛林（天界秘境入口，可由SPT直接传送）挑战阿加莎，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 海洋之心+暴击流（布鲁克克/布林克克海洋之心后谱尼等收尾）或秒杀流（魔焰猩猩绝命火焰）。

engine_notes: drain_each_turn: every turn the player's active pet loses a flat 100 HP and the boss heals 100 HP; once the boss is below 50% HP this becomes 200/200.
No innate boost; 绿光冲击 clears the player's boosts; 藤蔓抽打 15% fear.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page dated 2012-01-10: 80级, 约8000血; drain aura 100/200.

location.zh: 塞西利亚星冰原

capture.zh: 在塞西利亚星冰原挑战阿克希亚，打败获得阿克希亚精元（孵化得索拉）。

strategy_notes.zh: 不能把它磨到100血以下（会补满），要一招从100以上打到0：100级火系大招秒杀；或47+级雷吉欧斯全装备铁臂5次+充能3次后大招；魔焰猩猩觉醒后火系大招。

engine_notes: heal_full_below {hp 100}: whenever a hit leaves it at 1-99 HP it immediately returns to full HP, so it must be KO'd by a hit that takes it from >=100 to 0. Sources do not say the heal is limited to once; treated as unlimited.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).

location.zh: 泰若星 神兽谷

capture.zh: 先激活丛林秘境的枯枝机关，再到裂空星系泰若星第四层神兽谷挑战；打败获得暗夜冰狐的精元、成就「击败暗夜冰狐」与称号「暗夜猎手」。

strategy_notes.zh: 魔龙王魑魅魍魉、布鲁克克海洋之心等百分比扣血逐步削弱；或盖亚高伤害技能直接击杀。速度很慢（无极之冰+1后仍不到300）。

engine_notes: stages_unclearable: the innate stat stages applied at battle start cannot be removed by the player's clear_stages (消强) effects.
Innate double-defence boost (天生强化双防并且不可消去); +2 each is an estimate.
Immune to control skills, not 同生共死; susceptible to 海洋之心、圣灵魔闪光、魑魅魍魉、静电场.
Below 50% HP its crit rate rises (crit_rate_up, magnitude unknown).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

location.zh: 小幻影星 恶魔漩涡 守护残殿

capture.zh: 在小幻影星—恶魔漩涡—守护残殿挑战（开放当日仅7月9日出现；玩家流传通过刷异能王第一试炼进入辨认画面后前往守护残殿的方法）；打败获得巴索尔精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 草系克制光系；必带消强化精灵；用替死精灵吃掉命中下降，主战精灵上场重置命中；不要带着强化换人（会被复制）。

engine_notes: foe_stage_each_turn: the player's active pet loses 1 accuracy stage every turn (switching resets it).
copy_foe_boosts_on_switch_in: when a new player pet enters carrying stat boosts, those boosts are copied onto 巴索尔.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
immune_status: 不受异常状态影响.
Availability window (only appeared on 7月9日 at launch) is meta, not modelled.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 guide 2012-07: 血量大概10000, 天生攻击+2, 每回合命中-1, 复制强化, 不吃海洋之心/异常.

location.zh: 海盗研究基地

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系最后一个SPT精灵博卡特，在海盗研究基地挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 大比例扣血流+克制大招：盖亚石破天惊消强（随后被反弹击倒）→布鲁克克、布林克克不停海洋之心→魔焰猩猩两次觉醒后大招；火、地面、战斗系2倍。

engine_notes: reflect_damage 100%: every point of damage the player's pet deals is reflected back to it (反弹我方精灵打出的100%的伤害). Whether percentage damage (海洋之心) is reflected is unclear; strategies imply the 海洋之心 users faint eventually.
Innate atk+2 def+1 (clearable). 速度极慢 (spe x0.5 estimate).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

location.zh: 怀特矿场

capture.zh: 在怀特星怀特矿场挑战德拉萨，打败获得德拉萨精元（孵化得拉比）。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布叶绿光束消强化，然后大招；或盖亚、魔焰猩猩100级轮班，战斗系/火系克制冰龙；消强后上哈莫雷特直接大招。

engine_notes: Very thin sourcing: only the 4399 2011 summary (70级, 消强化 then 大招) and a 4399 问答 dated 2011-03-24.
Innate boost implied by '叶绿光束消强化'; atk+2 assumed. HP 5000 is an estimate.
skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).

location.zh: 怀特星 炫彩山 山神圣殿

capture.zh: 在炫彩山神秘洞窟收集齐4块灵魂残片，到最高层山神圣殿使用、点击山神解开封印后挑战；打败山神获得迪符特精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化，然后用魔焰猩猩/阿克希亚等秒杀技秒杀；或布林克克/布鲁克克海洋之心削血后黑电、斯普林特自杀，再上雷伊或谱尼收尾；该隐暗影护盾骗物攻MISS也可。

engine_notes: infinite_pp: the boss's skills never run out of PP (players could not win by 耗PP).
immune_status: 4399 says 烧伤、冻伤技能无效、免疫疲惫等异常状态; 海洋之心 (pct damage) explicitly works.
Battle displayed the level as '??' (等级问号级); level 80 is an estimate matching contemporary SPT bosses.
Unlock is an exploration step (collect 4 灵魂残片 in 炫彩山神秘洞窟), not a prior boss fight.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page (2011-08) gives HP 10000, PP无限 and status immunity; release 2011-06-10 per 4399 obtain guide.

location.zh: 光之迷城

label.zh: 周一：免疫异常状态，血很厚
周三：单次伤害超过150会反弹
周五：被打倒会回满血，只能用异常状态伤害终结
周六：防御很高，血越少越容易致命一击
周日：速度无限，体力低于1/5时秒杀任何精灵

capture.zh: 完成「披着七色光羽的精灵」任务后在塔克星光之迷城挑战厄尔塞拉，每天的特性不同；首次打败获得厄尔塞拉精元（孵化得塞拉），周一到周日都打败获得称号「七色光羽」。

strategy_notes.zh: 多用丽莎布布：周一花草能量3次+叶绿光束消强+金光绿叶；周二依卡莱恩/辛奇帕克或斯加尔卡自杀流；周三先减防再用草系（单击别超过150）；周四全力减防后丽莎强化满金光绿叶；周五依卡莱恩毒粉毒死；周六减防后丽莎进攻；周日精确控血，在它1/5体力以上时一口气打完。

engine_notes: Seven weekday rule sets become variants the player picks (no real-time clock, foundation 7.2). Variant `rules`/`phases` are ADDED to the top-level ones (unlimited PP, always-hit, immunities apply every day).

Fri: the boss fully revives whenever a direct hit KOs it (techbang: 5回合内体力被降为0会完全恢复, 最多6～7次瞬间补满3000血); only a KO by poison/burn/freeze damage sticks — revive_unless_status_ko + finish_with_status_damage.
Wed: any single hit dealing more than 150 damage is reflected (pct not stated; 100% assumed).
Mon 血很厚 (hp x2 estimate); Tue MISS超高 (evasion +3 estimate); Sat 防御很高 (def/spd +2 estimate) and 血越少越容易打致命 (read as: its crit rate rises as its HP falls; could also mean the player's crits — unclear).
HP 3000 inferred from techbang's Friday text (补满3000滴血); no source states its base HP directly.

Skills not named by any source; top learnset used. skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward.title_on_all_variants: grant the title 七色光羽 once every variant has been cleared.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 周一到周日规则全攻略 (2010-08-14) and 4399 问答 (2010-11-16) give the daily traits; techbang (2011-01) gives the Friday revive, immunities and 七色光羽.

location.zh: 神树之巅

capture.zh: 在神树之巅用头部射击左下角闪光的地方，BOSS出现后挑战；打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 带能造成异常状态并有睡眠技能的精灵（如罗德利斯）：烧伤→睡眠→补血循环；注意睡眠回合数，睡眠期间补血。

engine_notes: mirror_status_to_attacker: whenever the player inflicts poison/burn/freeze on 弗希斯, the player's own active pet receives the same status (对手中毒、烧伤或冻伤状态时，己方也会同时中相同状态). Sleep is NOT mirrored, which the classic burn→sleep→heal loop exploits.
Pre-battle requirement: shoot the flashing spot with the head-slot item (map interaction, not a battle rule).
Level/HP not published; 80 / 10000 estimates.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 聚侠 2012-12-28: status mirroring mechanic and burn→sleep→heal strategy; no HP/level given.

location.zh: 海洋星海底

capture.zh: SPT第二关：穿上潜水套装（机械室潜艇电路小游戏获得）进入海洋星三层（深处），挑战钢牙鲨；打败获得黑矿石（原版奖励为道具；本作统一为钢牙鲨精元，孵化得利牙鱼）。

strategy_notes.zh: 25级布布草强力吸取，或25+级电系精灵（30级雷伊鼠电火花3下），烈火猴30级以上用疯狂乱抓（别用火系技能）。

engine_notes: Pre-battle requirement: 潜水套装 to enter 海洋星三层 (map gate, not a battle rule).
Original reward was 黑矿石/黑晶矿 (a mining item); standardised to essence_gangyasha → 利牙鱼 #33.
HP never published; 250 is an estimate.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 水系, 海洋星三层, 25级; 7k7k 2011: 冰之牙/虚张声势/猛击/噪音, reward 黑矿石.

location.zh: 守护部落

capture.zh: 在守护部落挑战古尔扎迪，打败获得古尔扎迪精元、成就「击败古尔扎迪」和称号「毁灭者」。

strategy_notes.zh: 没有天生强化、速度不快、PP有限，可以耗招：鲁比克斜转耗光技能后丽莎布布收尾；或高个体丽莎布布花草能量强化两次，硬吃大地之怒，究极吸取回血，金光绿叶/叶绿光束收尾。

engine_notes: Normal finite PP (the classic tactic was 耗PP), high crit rate on its attacks per 4399; no extra rules.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page 2011-09-17: 80级, 约5000血, skills 大地之怒/巨石身躯/乱石风暴/混乱之雨.

location.zh: 龙王圣殿

capture.zh: 哈莫星龙王圣殿（早期随剧情出现在塔克星、斯科尔星）随时可挑战；打败获得哈莫雷特精元（孵化得哈莫）和成就。

strategy_notes.zh: 准备水、火、草三系精灵按「水→火→草」轮流出手（每打一下换一只），其他属性打它不掉血；先用2-3只精灵消掉龙之意志的强化，用依卡莱恩急转/暗影屏障耗光龙王波、龙爪闪空破的PP，再轮换输出。整场常要10-20分钟。

engine_notes: damage_only_from types water/fire/grass: other skill types deal 0.

type_rotation (stricter than no_repeat_type): a damaging hit only counts if its skill type is the next one in the cycle 水→火→草→水…; an out-of-order hit deals 0 (techbang 2011: 如果顺序错误的话，BOSS就不会损血). 7k7k phrases it as 每种属性只能打一次 (per cycle). Rotation is by skill type here; several guides phrase it by monster type (先上水系，然后上火系…) because each pet used its own STAB move.
Immune to 麻痹、寄生种子、中毒 and 海洋之心 (percent damage).
no_struggle: the classic plan was to drain its attack PP (龙王波/龙爪闪空破/龙王灭碎阵) and then rotate safely.
HP conflict: 7k7k 2011 says 3000; 4399 (2010-06-01) and weste (2010-09) say 10000. 10000 used (two 2010 sources, and the 10-20 minute fights).
龙之意志 (20269) raises its atk/def/spa by 1; clearing boosts first was standard.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 2010-06-01: 80级 10000血, 必须水火草轮流; 7k7k 2011: 仅受水火草属性招式有效，每种属性限打一次; techbang 2011-01: 顺序错误不损血, 免疫麻痹/寄生/中毒/海洋之心.

location.zh: 珊瑚海礁

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→凯洛亚，前往珊瑚海礁挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 魔焰猩猩秒杀流；或光母鸡（光蘑菇）消强→塔克林龙之威仪不断弱化→黑电自杀→圣光天马强化后大招打出1W+；谱尼可扛断流怒啸的固定伤害。

engine_notes: immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
Immune to DoT statuses (烧伤、冻伤、中毒) and control skills (灵魂干涉); 同生共死、寄生种子 ineffective. Stage-downs on it DO work (塔克林 strategy).
Innate boost (天生强化) — stats not stated; spa+1/spe+1 assumed. Frequently uses 水之结界 (all foe stats -1).
断流怒啸: 10% chance of +150 fixed damage (matches skill 12660).
Level/HP not published; 80 / 10000 are estimates.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-03-17: skills 异光幻流/断流怒啸/破浪念闪/水之结界; no level/HP given.

location.zh: 雾气石林

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→卡伦尼，在雾气石林挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 谱尼圣堂之门消强→圣光气→圣灵魔闪光输出；倒下后斯加尔卡电闪光滑阵自杀，达鲁切尔、魔焰猩猩、吉米丽娅强化后大招轮流输出，雷伊收尾；换人可重置它的叠加强化。

engine_notes: infinite_pp: the boss's skills never run out of PP (players could not win by 耗PP).
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts). (4399: 海洋之心无效(全部miss))
lifesteal: heals 1/3 of the damage its attacks deal.

escalate_vs_same_foe: while it keeps fighting the same player pet, after each of its attacks its atk and spa rise (攻击和特攻自动强化，下一回合攻击技能造成的伤害大幅提升); assumed +1/+1 per turn, reset when the player switches pets.
速度极其缓慢 — encoded as spe x0.5 (estimate).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-04-07: 血量8000（有待验证）, PP无限, 海洋之心无效, 伤害1/3回复自身.

location.zh: 巨石星 石源密林

capture.zh: 螺旋星系巨石星→熔岩大地→石源密林（或SPT面板直达），挑战卡沃尔，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 弱点圣灵、地面系。谱尼：圣堂之门消强→生命回血→圣光气→圣灵魔闪光轮；被麻痹时加血；或盖亚消强后谱尼/迈尔斯大招打出2500+。

engine_notes: status_on_attacker: whenever the player's pet successfully attacks 卡沃尔, the attacker is paralysed (100%).
Innate boost (天生强化) — stats not stated; spa+1/spe+1 assumed from its 冰雷幻阵.
Immune to control skills such as 灵魂干涉. 4399: 'this boss is weak: low attack, not fast'.
HP not published; 8000 estimated (contemporary 螺旋星系 SPT bosses had 8000-12000).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-03-05 and 螺旋星系 summary: 天生强化，我方攻击后100%麻痹.

location.zh: 露西欧星

capture.zh: 穿上高压水枪套装，用头部射击酒鬼克莱芬后直接进入对战；战斗胜利后获得克莱芬精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 第一次对战的克莱芬处于酒醉状态，「弱不禁风」，攻略作者直接用炎魔解决。

engine_notes: Pre-battle requirement: player must wear the 高压水枪 suit and shoot the boss with the head item; model as an unlock flag (item_suit_high_pressure_water_gun) rather than a battle rule.
Level and HP of the drunk first fight are not published; 60 / 2000 are estimates for a deliberately weak first fight.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 (2011-08 compilation) describes a two-step quest: drunk fight (gives 精元) then an 80级 rematch (achievement).

location.zh: 露西欧星

capture.zh: 击败酒醉的克莱芬后可再次挑战80级的清醒克莱芬，胜利获得成就「再次击败克莱芬」（精元已在第一战获得）。

strategy_notes.zh: 80级克莱芬速度很快，攻略作者用谱尼战胜。

engine_notes: Rematch reward is an achievement only; reward.monster is null.
HP not published; 5000 estimated from contemporary 80级 SPT bosses (古尔扎迪/米诺斯 ~5000).
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
bosses.source_note: 4399: 「这次是80级的克莱芬…速度貌似很不错…最后用谱尼战胜了」.

location.zh: 戴斯星（死亡之河）

capture.zh: 完成戴斯星历险后，脱掉身上全部装备来到戴斯星死亡之河，点击最左边的石像，克拉尼特划着渡船出场；50级第一战胜利获得克拉尼特精元（孵化得克拉尔）。

strategy_notes.zh: 带6只精灵且必须有水系：先派前5只（千万别出水系）耗光它的招式PP，再上水系精灵剑舞3-4次后秒杀；残血时补药。

engine_notes: Pre-battle requirement: the player must wear no equipment (戴斯星 can only be walked without gear) — unlock flag no_equipment.
PP-exhaust strategy is the classic answer, so no_struggle (a boss at 0 PP cannot act).
Immune to 同生共死, 镇魂歌, 极度冰点; its own skills always hit.
Skills: the Lv50 learnset top four (火光四溅/火龙的咆哮/龙族之力/进攻意识); HP not published (1500 estimate).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-11-22) and techbang (2011-01): 两次挑战 LV50 (精元) / LV80 (烈火之翼), 需脱装备.

location.zh: 戴斯星（死亡之河）

capture.zh: 打败50级克拉尼特后可再挑战80级克拉尼特，胜利获得称号/成就「烈火之翼」（精元已在第一战获得）。

strategy_notes.zh: 它只有两个攻击招（共10PP）和两个属性招：两只30级丘波斜转12-15次耗光攻击PP，再用会寄生种子的草系精灵慢慢吸死；或100级水系队伍虚张声势+剑舞后强攻。

engine_notes: Lv80 rematch: 强制先攻 (always_moves_first).
Skill set reconstructed from 4399's '两个攻击招（共10PP），两个属性招': 火龙红莲击 (PP5) + 赤色龙息 (PP5) + 进攻意识 + 自我暗示.
Reward is an achievement/title only; reward_hatches null.
HP not published (3000 estimate; 4399 rates the fight only 三星).
no_struggle matters: once both attack skills are at 0 PP it can only use status moves.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-11-22): 第二形态 80级, 两个攻击招共10PP + 两个属性招; techbang: 80级强制先攻, 奖励烈火之翼.

location.zh: 拉铂尔星

capture.zh: 完成资料室爱丽丝的「寻觅隐身之匙」任务获得巡查眼镜，戴上后到拉铂尔星点击中央的黑色油状物召唤肯佩德；打败获得肯佩德精元（孵化得佩奇）和成就。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化；打掉1/5血后它会狂暴（一招秒一只），所以要么一口气打完，要么用替身：谱尼灵魂干涉→斯加尔卡自杀→雷伊雷神觉醒强化后雷神天明闪秒杀；丽莎护体磨、厄尔塞拉光芒附体6次+八尺镜大招也可。小心反射盾。

engine_notes: Berserk: after losing 1/5 of its HP (below 80%) it enters 狂暴状态 and each attack one-shots any pet (ohko_attacks).
Reflect: '有反弹伤害的招式' / '反射盾' — damage reflection; whether always-on or a skill-triggered shield, and the percentage, are not given (always-on 25% assumed).
Innate boost (先消强化) — stat not stated; atk+1 assumed.
Skills not named; top learnset used. skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 5068 (2011-01): 80级 10000血, 巡查眼镜, 反弹伤害+狂暴; 4399 BOSS page (2011-01-17): 打掉五分之一血后狂暴一招秒任意精灵.

location.zh: 浮空仙岛

capture.zh: 在浮空仙岛挑战天马一族长老库里，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化，纳多雷反转约3次，布鲁海洋之心约3次，自杀型精灵上场，再由水球精灵强化2次后大招击杀（伤害7000+，强化3次9000+）。

engine_notes: random_heal: 'has a chance to heal' (有几率回血) — chance and amount not given (20% / 10% max HP are placeholders). Its 星光奔腾击 already has 15% to heal 1/4 HP; the 'chance to heal' may simply be that effect.
海洋之心 works (used in the reference strategy).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 7k7k 2012-11-12: 体力1w, 有几率回血, 攻击+2, 普通系.

location.zh: 巨石星 巨石岛

capture.zh: 螺旋星系巨石星，点击地图中的石像挑战；打败获得兰斯特的精元和成就「击败兰斯特」，精元经分子转化器孵化得到卡斯。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布+布鲁克克/布林克克+消强精灵：盖亚消强，海洋之心磨到半血以下，丽莎布布强化后大招带过；用飞行、草、超能系克制。

engine_notes: reflect_damage: any single hit dealing more than 1200 damage reflects 1/4 of that damage to the attacker.
Once, when at low HP (残血), it heals a flat 500 HP; the exact threshold is not stated (20% assumed).
海洋之心 works; 寄生种子 does not. Frequently uses 大地崩裂 to weaken the player.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

location.zh: 沃尔夫洞穴

label.zh: 愈合领域（原11:00-12:00）：双方每回合恢复10%体力
极限领域（原14:00-15:00）：双方每回合扣100体力
能量领域（原19:00-20:00）：双方伤害翻倍

capture.zh: 完成任务「奇妙的新生命」后，在比格星沃尔夫洞穴召唤并挑战劳克蒙德；每天三个时段各有一种领域；打败获得劳克蒙德精元（孵化得劳特）。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化再打；速度250以上就能先手；用超能、飞行、暗影/电系克制，魔焰猩猩、阿克希亚等秒杀型精灵速战速决，能量领域时段（双方伤害翻倍）最有利。

engine_notes: Three time-window fields become variants (no real-time clock): healing = both sides heal 10% max HP per turn; extreme = both lose 100 HP per turn; energy = both deal double damage.
alternating_immunity: on even turns it becomes immune to one damage class, cycling 特殊攻击无效 → 物理攻击无效 → 属性攻击无效 (techbang: 每个领域时段偶数回合会依照顺序出现…).
Innate boost (天然强化，最好是消强化再打) — stats not stated; atk+1/spe+1 assumed (matches its 规则掌控).
unlimited_pp and 100% accuracy per techbang. Very high crit damage noted; no number.

Skills not named by sources; top learnset used. skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-10-16): 5000血, 三领域, 需完成奇妙的新生命; techbang (2011-01): 时段, PP无限, 偶数回合轮流无效.

location.zh: 双子贝塔星

capture.zh: 在双子贝塔星荒原挑战雷纳多，打败获得雷纳多精元（孵化得雷格）。

strategy_notes.zh: 80+级火系（洛奇拉斯）火攻，再换巴鲁斯水枪/漩涡每回合约175伤害；或虚张声势降攻后漩涡磨；魔焰猩猩觉醒2次大招秒杀。残血（1/8以下）时它每击都是致命一击，最后要一口气打完。

engine_notes: Below 1/8 HP every attack it makes is a critical hit (体力低于1/8时每次攻击都是致命一击) — phase at 12.5% → always_crit.
属性复制 (20145): for 5 turns its type becomes the foe's type; handled by the skill.
HP not given by the sources found (1500 is from earlier research notes citing 7k7k; not re-verified).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 双子贝塔星荒原 75级; 7k7k 2011: 体力低于1/8时每次攻击都是致命一击.

location.zh: 火山星洞穴深处

capture.zh: 在火山星山洞深处挑战里奥斯；打败「有可能」获得里奥斯精元（孵化得胡里亚），第一次打败可获得蓝武士装。

strategy_notes.zh: 布布花40+级地震，尤里安31+级克制，巴拉龟36级水尾，烈焰猩猩39级+5-6瓶高级体力药，巴鲁斯泡沫光线/潮汐，波克尔同生共死。

engine_notes: AI: 血多时用密集火网，血少时用回击（必定后发, priority -1）. Encoded as weighted AI favouring 密集火网, switched at 50% HP to 回击/报复; the exact threshold is not stated.
Reward was not guaranteed (打败它有可能获得) — reward.chance 50 is an estimate; first_clear_items gives the 蓝武士装 suit part once.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 火山星山洞深处 35级 340滴血; 7k7k 2011: 血少时用回击必定后发.

location.zh: 晶蛇魔窟

capture.zh: 在晶蛇魔窟挑战洛拉斯克，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 未找到同期攻略；地面系，草、水、冰、飞行（免疫地面技能）系有利。

engine_notes: No 2012 source for this fight was found. Rules (immune_pct_damage, immune_status, innate atk+2, 10000 HP) are a placeholder modelled on the neighbouring SPT bosses (库里 2012-11, 伊索里 2012-12) and must be verified.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: Only species data and the game's SPT list (habitat 晶蛇魔窟) were available; era inferred from species id between 库里 and 伊索里.

location.zh: 怀特星魔窟

capture.zh: 在怀特星魔窟挑战米诺斯，打败后获得1个米诺斯精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 用飞行、机械、超能系克制：盖亚日月皆伤+返璞归真消耗，艾尔伊洛星体解离术，迪普利德魔力漩涡，闪光艾菲亚无限之光收尾。

engine_notes: No special rules reported by 4399; 4399 names 狂暴烈袭 and 魂之审判 — the other two slots are the species' remaining top learnset skills.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

location.zh: 墨杜萨星

capture.zh: 在墨杜萨星挑战墨杜萨，战胜后获得墨杜萨精元（孵化得莎莎）和成就。

strategy_notes.zh: 光系免疫超能：派光系精灵（厄尔塞拉等）上场，它只会用决然一击；先消强化；或寄生种子+防护罩，准备三个替死鬼精灵。

engine_notes: vs_type_use_only: while the player's active pet is 光系 it only uses 决然一击 (普通系) — its 超能 moves do 0 to light (type chart psychic→light = 0).
Below 1/2 HP every attack crits (体力低于2分之一会暴击).

Skills besides 决然一击 not named; top learnset used. skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2011-01-12): 80级, 2000血, 体力低于1/2会暴击, 打光系只会用决然一击, 精元+成就.

location.zh: 克洛斯星林间

capture.zh: SPT第一关：在克洛斯星林间挑战蘑菇怪，打败即可获得「退化小蘑菇」（原版奖励是道具而非精元；本作统一为蘑菇怪精元，孵化得小蘑菇）。

strategy_notes.zh: 新手关：17-20级小火猴反复火焰车（带3瓶体力药），或23-30级伊优钢之爪，或20-27级布布种子疾风刃+吸收；高等级精灵乱打即死。

engine_notes: Original reward was the item 退化小蘑菇, not a 精元; the brief standardises SPT rewards to essences (essence_moguguai → 小蘑菇 #46).
Level conflict: 4399 (2010-06) says 15级, 7k7k/4399 summaries (2011) say 10级. 15 used (older source).
HP never published; 120 is an estimate (~2x its natural Lv15 HP, in line with 里奥斯 Lv35 = 340).
No special rules; skills 针刺/撞击/毒粉/瞪眼 as listed by every source.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 克洛斯星林间 15级, 针刺/撞击/毒粉/瞪眼, reward 退化小蘑菇.

location.zh: 斯诺岩洞

capture.zh: 在斯诺星岩洞挑战魔狮迪露（50级，总体力300万）；打败获得魔狮迪露精元（孵化得露露）。

strategy_notes.zh: 靠叠加异常的百分比伤害：先上布布花/依卡莱恩寄生种子，再上冻伤（阿克希亚/依依）、烧伤（里奥斯）、中毒（毒粉），在它跌破一半体力之前叠满；或阿克希亚极度冰点、魔焰猩猩绝命火焰直接秒杀。

engine_notes: HP 3,000,000 in ONE battle (not a server-wide pool): every source frames it as a single fight beaten by stacking percentage damage — 寄生/冻伤/烧伤/中毒 each take 1/8 max HP (375,000) per turn, so 3-4 stacked statuses kill it in 2-3 turns. No source describes HP carrying over between battles, so no chain/carry_hp is used (correcting the foundation 7.2 guess).
ignore_type_chart: 不受任何系精灵克制 — every hit on it uses multiplier 1.

ohko_attacks below 50% (体力少于150万: 秒杀任何精灵，无视任何副作用、无视速度、无视等级) — it acts first and every attack KOs. Later summaries (4399 2010-06-01, weste 2010-09, 7k7k 2011) give the threshold as 1/4; 50% is from the detailed 4399/7k7k boss pages.
block_new_status below 1,000,000 HP (他血低于100万时异常效果无效): new statuses fail; statuses already on it keep ticking.
damage_scales_with_hp_lost: 体力越少攻击越强 (no formula given).
Not immune to ohko ops: 极度冰点 and 绝命火焰 were standard answers.
Status damage here follows RULES 7: poison/burn/freeze/leech each take 1/8 max HP per turn (percent damage), and several DoT statuses can be on the boss at once (classic 叠加异常).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 & 7k7k (2010-05/06): 50级 总体力300万, 不受任何系克制, 150万以下秒杀, 100万以下异常无效, 不免疫冻伤/烧伤/中毒/寄生.

location.zh: 双子阿尔法星

capture.zh: 在双子阿尔法星岩地挑战纳多雷，打败获得纳多雷精元（孵化得纳格）。

strategy_notes.zh: 火系、水系、草系克制地面：鲁斯王剑舞2次后水天一色秒杀；57级布布花叶片风暴+寄生种子再上烈焰猩猩火焰漩涡；提亚斯精神干涉也能轻松打。注意属性反转。

engine_notes: 属性反转 (skill 20113): for 5 turns its type and the foe's type are swapped, flipping the player's type advantage; handled by the skill's own effect.
防御极高 (4399: 'extremely high defence', authors guessed 2000-3000 HP from how long it took). HP 1400 per 4399 and 7k7k; def x1.5 encodes the high-defence remark (estimate).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05) and 7k7k 2011: 双子阿尔法星岩地, 70级, 1400血, 属性反转/风沙暴击/风沙尘暴/空掌破.

location.zh: 艾迪星

capture.zh: 在艾迪星挑战奈尼芬多，打败获得奈尼芬多精元（孵化得奈姬）。

strategy_notes.zh: 不要喝体力药（药剂反噬会把回复量变成扣血），活力药可以喝；布鲁海洋之心削血，丽莎布布花草能量强化+究极吸取/花草护体循环磨死；光、暗影系伤害较大。

engine_notes: 药剂反噬 (skill 20314, its signature): for 5 turns the player's HP potions deal their heal amount as damage instead (喝多少体力药就扣多少血); PP potions (活力药) unaffected. Healing SKILLS (究极吸取, 花草护体) still work in every guide, so the foundation's 'block_heal' is narrower here: it is the skill effect, not a battle-wide rule.
Immune to 烧伤、中毒、寄生种子; 海洋之心 and 暗影屏障-type status moves work.
速度无敌: always_moves_first. 容易致命: crit_rate_up (+1, estimate).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 免疫烧伤、中毒、寄生种子, 药物反噬; 4399 2010-06-01: 艾迪星 60级 8000血 速度无限.

location.zh: 恶灵深渊（火山口）

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→纳特→现在就去，在火山口连续点击3次触发战斗；打败获得纳特精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 强化消不掉、弱化无效，用水系、圣灵系精灵车轮战（布鲁卡卡、鲁斯王、迈尔斯、斯加尔卡、斯普林特）。

engine_notes: stages_unclearable: the innate stat stages applied at battle start cannot be removed by the player's clear_stages (消强) effects.
status_on_attacker: after the player's pet attacks it, the attacker is burned for 2-3 turns (必出现2-3回合烧伤).
速度奇慢（比速度184的鲁斯王还慢）: spe x0.4 estimate so every player pet moves first.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 guide 2012-10-12: 体力8000, 天生攻击+2无法消强化, 不吃弱化与异常, 攻击后烧伤2-3回合.

location.zh: 兽神瀑布

capture.zh: 在兽神瀑布挑战帕里斯，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 电系强攻（水暗影被电4倍）：盖亚石破天惊消强化，雷伊雷神觉醒后雷神天明闪致命一击；光、草系也较有效。

engine_notes: foe_status_each_turn: from the 2nd turn on, the player's active pet is always poisoned (必有中毒状态).
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
immune_status / immune_stage_down: 不受异常状态影响, 不吃属性消弱技能.
谱尼虚无 (damage immunity skill) is ineffective against it.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

location.zh: 泰若星 丛林之境

capture.zh: 进入裂空星系泰若星二层丛林之境，点击右下角的鸟蛋出现皮特萨罗，战胜后获得一个皮特萨罗精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 用电系或冰系（雷伊、杜尼鲁）：魔龙消强并弱化 → 斯普林特自杀 → 雷伊雷神觉醒强化后致命一击秒杀。

engine_notes: Innate special-attack boost (天生特攻强化); magnitude not stated, +1 assumed.
Below half HP the player's pets' accuracy drops (血量降至一半时我方精灵命中率下降); encoded as a one-time foe acc -1, magnitude/repeat unknown.
Weakening works but its skill 绝灭射线 removes its own stat drops; often uses 怒鸣.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

location.zh: 米娜村落

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→普兰特，在米娜村落挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 雷伊（极光刃/雷神天明闪/雷神觉醒）先消掉攻击强化，黑电斯加尔卡自杀，魔焰猩猩两次觉醒后大招带过；火、圣灵、飞行（冰、暗影）系克制；小心睡眠。

engine_notes: immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
immune_stage_down: 属性消弱吸能无效.
Innate 攻击等级+2 (sic; the 4399 text says attack even though the species is a special attacker) — boost can be cleared (雷伊消强).
暴击率很高 — crit_rate_up; 偶尔使用技能还会先手 — random_priority (chance estimated).
Boss version of 混沌绿光 puts the player to sleep at least 50% of the time (learnset version: 10%); 蚀梦术 is said to crit 25% vs sleeping targets.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-05-19: 8000血量, 天生攻击+2, 暴击率很高, 海洋之心无效.

location.zh: 推特星 加利部落

capture.zh: 完成任务「决战瑞尔斯」后在卡兰星系推特星加利部落挑战，只能派一只精灵；打败获得瑞尔斯的精元、成就「击败瑞尔斯」与称号「高傲的狂战者」。

strategy_notes.zh: 只有一只精灵上场，必须先手瞬杀：盖亚石破天惊、闪光艾菲亚超能石之力—S，或托鲁克强化攻击后飓风利袭秒杀。

engine_notes: Single-pet challenge (仅能使用一只精灵).
ignore_player_damage_reduction: the player's protect/damage-reduction effects (谱尼虚无、希莉娅摇曳、该隐暗影护盾…) do nothing against it.
攻击力超高，基本可秒杀大部分精灵 — encoded as stat_multipliers atk 2.0 (estimate) on top of its ~2000 HP.
风林火山 clears its own stat drops, so weakening is pointless.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page: 2011-12-23 加入, 80级, 2000血左右, 单精灵挑战.

location.zh: 海盗能源站

capture.zh: 在海盗能源站挑战斯宾塞，打败后获得斯宾塞精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 厄尔塞拉金光闪烁消强化；布林克克、布鲁克克各用5次以上海洋之心（百分比伤害不受1点限制）；降到1/5以下后用厄尔塞拉造成烧伤使护盾失效，最后谱尼圣灵魔闪光收尾。

engine_notes: Signature mechanic (很难受到伤害): every physical or special attack deals exactly 1 damage. Percentage damage (海洋之心) and status damage are not capped.

damage_cap_breaks_on_dot: while the boss is burned/frozen/poisoned the 1-damage shield 'has a high chance to disappear' (4399: 有很大机率会消失); chance 80 is an estimate — model as a per-hit roll while the boss has a DoT status.
Innate boost exists (天生有强化，可消掉) but which stat is not stated; spa+1 is a guess. It CAN be cleared.
Below 1/5 HP every boss attack is a critical hit (always_crit).
Control/weaken skills 'basically ineffective' (同生共死、寄生种子、控场技能、弱化技能基本无效).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 SPT page 2011-10-08: 80级, 5000血左右; 物攻/特攻只减1滴血; 掉血状态下特效大概率消失; 1/5血以下每次致命一击.

location.zh: 通天塔

capture.zh: 在通天塔挑战斯克鲁（魔神艾里克的部下），打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 未找到同期攻略；冰系，火、战斗、机械、地面系克制。

engine_notes: No 2012 source for this fight was found. Rules (immune_pct_damage, immune_status, innate atk+2) are a placeholder modelled on the neighbouring 螺旋星系 SPT bosses (帕里斯 2012-08, 纳特 2012-10) and must be verified.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: Only species data and the game's SPT list (habitat 通天塔) were found; era inferred from species id between 帕里斯 and 纳特.

location.zh: 上古龙殿

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→斯利普→现在就去，来到上古龙殿，点击沉睡中的斯利普挑战；打败获得斯利普精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 没有明显强化、吃属性相克，较好打：凯洛亚水之结界弱化/补血→斯加尔卡自杀→盖亚返璞归真强化后石破天惊秒杀；战斗系精灵有效。

engine_notes: 4399: 每回合容易给我方精灵造成睡眠和害怕状态 — sleep likely from its 打盹/boss-only effects, fear from 展翅冲锋 (15%). The 4th skill is a guess (打盹 21422 fits the 'sleeping dragon' theme); engine may need a boss-only sleep-inflicting variant.
速度极慢 — spe x0.5 estimate.
HP and level not measured by the guide (作者用盖亚秒杀); estimates.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 guide 2012-04-27: slow, frequent sleep/fear, no innate boost; HP 'not measured'.

location.zh: 地底古迹

capture.zh: 在钮斯处接受「忍之秘宝第四季」，激活塔克星忍魂密室的全部四个玄关后，斯普林特在第二层地底古迹复苏，点击挑战；打败获得斯普林特精元（孵化得斯林德）。

strategy_notes.zh: 「这个新BOSS并不难」：40级以上波克尔/闪光波克尔同生共死一次后收尾；或盖亚消强化后谱尼解决。

engine_notes: 同生共死 works (the cheapest classic strategy), so it is not immune to it.
Innate boost implied by '先用盖亚消强化'; spa+1 assumed. HP and level: 4399 2011 summary says 80级; HP 4000 is an estimate.
Its 虚空之身/黑暗遮蔽 make physical/special attacks miss for 2 turns — skill effects.
skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 图鉴 + 5068 (2011-04-29): 忍魂密室第二层地底古迹, 激活四玄关后出现, 精元孵化斯林德; 4399 2011: 80级.

location.zh: 南瓜星 藏宝密室

capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→斯图尔特，在南瓜星藏宝密室挑战；打败获得斯图尔特精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 光、暗影、次元系2倍克制，光系不吃超能技能：光系强化单挑流，或自爆+克制系大招强攻流。作者评价「异常好打」。

engine_notes: foe_stage_each_turn: the player's active pet loses 1 speed stage every turn.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
infinite_pp: the boss's skills never run out of PP (players could not win by 耗PP).
HP conflict: 4399 pet page says 10000体力, the detailed 4399 guide says 12000体力 (used here).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 4399 guide 2012-10-26: 12000体力 (pet page: 10000), 天生攻击+2, 每回合我方速度-1, PP无限.

location.zh: 龙王圣殿

capture.zh: 哈莫星龙王圣殿（三龙之一）挑战塔克林，打败获得塔克林精元（孵化得塔米）。

strategy_notes.zh: 先用丽莎布布叶绿光束等消掉天生物攻+2，再降它物攻；用毒粉、漩涡、火焰漩涡等叠加中毒/烧伤/冻伤，三重状态伤害约2回合KO；准备多只精灵轮换。

engine_notes: Innate 物攻+2 (天生强化物攻+2，物攻900左右，消除完为450左右) — clearable.

All skills crit 1/4 of the time (crit_rate_up +2 ≈ 25%, estimate); once its HP is below 10000 every attack is a crit (techbang: 体力降到10000以下时每次攻击必定致命一击) → phase at 76.9% of 13000. 4399 instead says it crits often below 1/4 HP.
Poison, burn, freeze and fatigue work; immune to 寄生种子, 同生共死, 极度冰点.
Cosmetic: 每次攻击后位置会前移 (sprite moves forward) — not modelled.
Speed below 180. 灰飞烟灭 hit 3 of the player's pets in the 3v3 team battle version; single-target here.
Status damage here follows RULES 7: poison/burn/freeze/leech each take 1/8 max HP per turn (percent damage), and several DoT statuses can be on the boss at once (classic 叠加异常).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-09-26): 血量13000, 天生物攻+2, 可中毒/烧伤/冻伤, 免疫寄生; 4399 2011 summary: 80级.

location.zh: 龙王圣殿

capture.zh: 哈莫星龙王圣殿（三龙之一）挑战塔西亚，打败获得塔西亚精元（孵化得塔拉）。

strategy_notes.zh: 别用物理攻击（命中低且会被害怕）；带水火草电战斗系的特攻手：丽莎布布祈雨/花草能量循环强化，适度补血，用特攻大招；魔焰猩猩、鲁斯王也可。

engine_notes: unlimited_pp; immune to 寄生/毒/烧伤/冻伤 and to stat drops (免疫弱化技能), 同生共死, 极度冰点.
status_on_attacker fear (physical only): taking physical damage makes the attacker afraid (4399: 非常高几率; techbang: 100%).
foe_accuracy_penalty 30: every skill used against it has its accuracy reduced by 30% (techbang: 任何技能对其命中率降低30%).
always_hit: its own skills always hit (自身技能命中率100%).
魔龙咒 struck twice per turn in the original 3v3 team version (可同时攻击2只精灵，一回合可攻击2次); single-target here.
Known 2010 bug: 龙之结界's text said it lowers the foe's 双攻 but it actually lowered 双防 — the catalog skill follows the text.
Level: 4399 2011 summary says 70级 (techbang only gives a recommended LV100).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-09-26): 血量10000左右, 免疫寄生/毒/烧伤/冻伤, 免疫弱化, PP无限, 物攻高几率被害怕.

location.zh: 云霄星最高层

capture.zh: 在云霄星最高处挑战提亚斯，打败获得提亚斯精元（孵化得米拉美）；若它用了两次精神干涉就会自动逃跑，本次不算胜利。

strategy_notes.zh: 35+级波克尔同生共死后换45-50级烈焰猩猩收尾；或100级精灵大招速攻，在它第二次精神干涉之前解决；必中技能可以无视命中下降。

engine_notes: flee_after_skill {skill 20082 精神干涉, count 2}: on the second successful use of 精神干涉 the boss leaves; the battle ends as a failure (lose: boss_fled).
打它容易MISS: explained by 精神干涉 itself (foe accuracy -2 per use); no extra evasion rule added.
它却容易致命一击: crit_rate_up +2 stages at battle start (magnitude is an estimate).
HP never published; 500 is an estimate.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 云霄星最高处 45级; 「打它容易MISS，它却容易致命一击，只要它两次精神干涉就自动逃跑」.

location.zh: 拓梯星

capture.zh: 完成「活力之匙」任务后到罗格星系拓梯星活力源泉，点击出现的冰柱挑战亚伦斯；打败获得亚伦斯精元（48小时孵化得冰妖）。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化，再两次海洋之心把它削到约2000，剩下的精灵车轮战；魔焰猩猩绝命火焰有机会秒杀；火、机械、战斗系强化后大招轮流打。

engine_notes: drain_each_turn: every turn the player's active pet loses 100 HP and 亚伦斯 heals 100 (每回合从对方吸取100血，回复自身100血).
海洋之心 (percent damage) works; 寄生种子 does not.
Innate boost (先上来消强化) — stat not stated; spa+1 assumed. 速度非常慢 (spe x0.5 estimate), 攻击很弱.

Only 交错冰柱 is named (sina 2011); other slots from the learnset. skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2011-02-28): 体力5000, 每回合吸100补100, 海洋之心有效寄生无效; sina blog: 2011-02-25 加入, 80级.

location.zh: 冰晶奇宫

capture.zh: 瞭望舱【热门精灵推荐】第三页可前往新场景冰晶奇宫挑战伊索里；打败获得伊索的精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 飞行/超能系克制：帕罗狄亚带禁制领域与大招为主力，斯加尔卡或斯普林特自杀辅助；尽量在它1/4血以上时打出大伤害。

engine_notes: stages_unclearable for def/spd only: normal 消强 removes its atk boost but not the double-defence boost.
foe_cannot_boost: the player's pets cannot raise their stat stages during this fight (我方不能强化).
Below 1/4 HP its attack damage doubles.
immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
Control skills and DoT statuses do not work (immune_status).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
bosses.source_note: 聚侠 2012-12-07: 100级, 10000体力, 天生攻击/防御/特防+2, 1/4以下伤害翻倍, 我方不能强化.

location.zh: 拜伦号（幽灵飞船）

capture.zh: 在拜伦号（幽灵飞船）挑战尤纳斯，打败获得尤纳斯精元（孵化得影球）；最后一滴血只能用「幻影」打掉。

strategy_notes.zh: 布布花/依卡莱恩寄生种子+吃药硬撑，强化防御后一直寄生把它吸到1滴血；再换速度130以上的布鲁/神鹿（里奥斯）用幻影收尾。注意黑暗之核加特攻后的黑暗之门。

engine_notes: hp_floor_until {skill 10100 幻影}: damage from anything else (including 寄生 drain) cannot take it below 1 HP; only a hit by 幻影 (普通系 physical, learnt by 里奥斯/神鹿) can remove the last HP.

Status: 4399 (2010-06): 'BOSS不再受冻伤、中毒等异常状态影响' (a patch removed DoT cheese), yet 寄生种子 is still the core strategy in every 2010-2011 guide, so leech is NOT in the immunity list. Burn assumed immune with poison/freeze.
unlimited_pp_skill: 黑暗之门 (无限次数) never runs out of PP; its other skills have normal PP.
HP: 2800 (4399 2010, 7k7k 2011, 4399 问答 2011). The 怀旧服 6000 HP / 攻击+2 version is the 2013 S-mode rework, not used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
bosses.source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 70级 血量2800, 黑暗之门（无限次数）, 最后一滴血只能通过幻影打掉, 不受冻伤、中毒影响.

No cooperative lobby, other-player requirement, random-floor ladder, or multiplayer formation is implemented. engine_notes: User-requested single-player adaptation: exactly one Seville opponent. Tarklin and Tasia are not added as cooperative teammates or as an artificial three-enemy raid. Their existing ordinary challenges and the Azure Dragon guardian sequence remain unchanged.

Level 80 and 10000 HP are authored solo difficulty values, not a reconstruction of historical cooperative difficulty. A 2010 guide reports approximately 140000 HP for the cooperative version; that multiplayer value is intentionally not reused.

The retained four skill IDs are original species-413 learnset skills. Source discussions identify Dragon Flight and Immortal Will as common actions. Status immunity is bounded to the poison, burn, freeze and leech effects described by period guides.

The period guide reports healing below 200 HP. The existing engine rule uses the absolute field heal_full_below {hp:200}, restoring full HP when nonlethal damage leaves the solo body below that threshold. Exact original healing amount and hook timing remain uncertified.

Official MapConfig symbol 155 identifies map 349 as Challenge Seville, with replacement map 1147. The remake uses its already modeled Dragon Temple meeting point; it does not claim to render the original map-349 encounter scene.
bosses.source_note: Period SPT guides identify the Seville battle, essence reward, original cooperative three-dragon format, common actions and low-HP recovery. The current one-opponent solo format and HP/level calibration are explicit remake choices requested by the user.
